organization.name_en: Center of Excellence in Communication Innovation for the Development of Quality of Life and Sustainability
organization.faculty: Faculty of Communication Arts, Chulalongkorn University
organization.tagline: COMMUNICATION INNOVATION FOR A BETTER LIFE
organization.description: A research center dedicated to creating knowledge and developing communication innovations that enhance quality of life and sustainability through research, tool development, education, and collaborative networks across government, private, and civil society sectors.

objectives: Developing communication innovation for the improvement of quality of life and sustainability through teaching, learning, and training management.
Coming together as a group or community to advocate for communication aimed at collectively developing the quality of life and sustainability within society.
Developing innovative tools and equipment to help society understand and perceive the guidelines for developing quality of life and sustainability.

services.name: Book & Printing
services.description: Book and print materials production. Study, review academic documents, synthesize, and write original content. Design and produce books and printed materials.

services.name: Motion Effect & AR
services.description: Create AR (Augmented Reality). AR on books, AR on packaging, AR for marketing promotion, AR for education.

services.name: Video Production
services.description: Organization introduction video, Company introduction video, Work summary video, Educational/Instructional video, Research findings dissemination video.

services.name: Training
services.description: Assess needs, design curriculum, create manuals, manage training, evaluate training, assess training.

services.name: Research & Evaluation
services.description: Create research frameworks, Establish evaluation frameworks, Design research projects, tools, Collect and Analyze research data, Evaluate project outcomes, Prepare evaluation reports.

services.name: Communication Design
services.description: Create infographics, communicate through images, design posters, design printed materials, design posts for social media, create 3D maps.

services.name: Campaign Manage
services.description: Analyze the situation, Study target groups, Determine channels, Create core content, Craft key messages, Produce promotional materials, Design activities, Conduct campaigns, Summarize results.

services.name: Seminar
services.description: Set agendas, coordinate speakers, invite participants, arrange venues and prepare equipment, conduct discussions, synthesize information, prepare reports, summarize meetings.

services.name: Marketing Event
services.description: Event design, venue arrangement, coordinating speakers, inviting participants, arranging lighting and stage decoration, organizing launches, broadcasting news on TV and online, evaluating event outcomes.
